close_reason: Updated reg! macro in jmap-mail-server to use ClosureHandlerWithCtx; _ctx: C parameter now available in all handler closures; doc comment updated; all tests pass; clippy clean
description:
Update register_mail_handlers to use ClosureHandlerWithCtx<B, C> (from JMAP-exue.1) so CallerCtx is forwarded to every mail handler closure.

Current: macro reg! builds ClosureHandler closures |b, ci, a| that ignore the caller.
New: macro reg_ctx! builds ClosureHandlerWithCtx closures |b, ci, a, ctx| — ctx is the forwarded CallerCtx.

Handler functions that need per-request auth should accept an additional ctx: C parameter. For the initial pass, add the parameter with _ctx naming so it compiles without callers having to change anything yet.

Acceptance criteria:
- register_mail_handlers closures receive CallerCtx as a fourth argument
- All 26 handlers compile with the new signature
- cargo test -p jmap-mail-server exits 0
- Clippy clean

Depends on JMAP-exue.1 (ClosureHandlerWithCtx in jmap-server).
title: jmap-mail-server: Forward CallerCtx in register_mail_handlers
